summary: LLM7 documents a free dashboard token for current tier:turbo text-generation models with usage_based_only:false, not every catalog model or Pro/paid-only models. Limits are 1 request per second, 60 per minute, 250 per hour, and 100,000 input-plus-output tokens per 24 hours. Its current limits page no longer documents anonymous access. The free-token allowance may be reduced without notice based on demand, capacity, model availability, fair use and abuse prevention; it is not guaranteed capacity. Image/video billing follows separate allowance/balance rules, not a promise of 100K free image/video tokens.
claim_steps: Obtain a free token from the LLM7 dashboard at dash.llm7.io.

Check https://api.llm7.io/v1/models and select a current text-generation model with tier:turbo and usage_based_only:false. Send an OpenAI-compatible request using that model ID and your free dashboard token; Pro or usage_based_only:true models require paid accounting.
Check live availability and dashboard allowance. Stay within 1 request/second, 60/minute, 250/hour and 100,000 input-plus-output tokens/24 hours; quotas may be reduced without notice.
Turbo pricing metadata is for paid usage accounting, not proof the documented free allowance has ended. Image/video allowance and balance rules are separate.

social_proof.title: LLM7 free-token capacity caveat
social_proof.text: Free-token quotas are provided at no charge and may be reduced without notice based on demand, service capacity, model availability, fair-use calculations, abuse-prevention controls, and other operational factors.
